scope: Pilot preparation only; frozen before first pilot ranking, after upstream Day6 results existed. Not prospective registration of discovery.
threshold_source: broad_screening/config.py high_target_support_cells=300 and high_effect_pp=20; configs/clue_discovery/replogle_day6_frozen.yaml support and alpha gates
directional_support: enrichment: perturbation_hits; depletion: sum(nt_hits in occupied perturbation batches)
overlap_policy: Greedy A then B then C then D; each eligible candidate may satisfy multiple slots, but is selected once. D uses first available structural tier after deduplication.
empty_slot_policy: FAIL_CLOSED; never relax thresholds, priorities or deduplication; no Case Files published unless all four slots fill
boundary: No mechanistic question, hypothesis, prediction, Evidence Queue, EvidenceRecord, claim audit, route or final case report. Initialize revision 1 with clue_ready / next_actor none; do not run Agents.
